001package com.streamConverter.examples;
002
003import com.streamConverter.StreamConverter;
004import com.streamConverter.command.IStreamCommand;
005import com.streamConverter.command.impl.CsvNavigateCommand;
006import com.streamConverter.command.impl.JsonNavigateCommand;
007import com.streamConverter.command.impl.SampleStreamCommand;
008import com.streamConverter.command.impl.XmlNavigateCommand;
009import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
010import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
011import java.io.IOException;
012import java.io.InputStream;
013import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
014import org.slf4j.Logger;
015import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
016
017/**
018 * Comprehensive demo application for StreamConverter.
019 *
020 * <p>This demo showcases various features of the StreamConverter including: - CSV navigation and
021 * column selection - JSON navigation with JSONPath-like expressions - XML navigation with XPath
022 * expressions - Command chaining and pipeline processing
023 */
024public class StreamConverterDemo {
025
026  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(StreamConverterDemo.class);
027
028  /**
029   * アプリケーションのエントリーポイント。StreamConverterのデモを実行します。
030   *
031   * @param args コマンドライン引数（使用されません）
032   */
033  public static void main(String[] args) {
034    logger.info("=== StreamConverter Demo Application ===\n");
035
036    try {
037      // Demo 1: CSV Navigation
038      demoCSVNavigation();
039
040      // Demo 2: JSON Navigation
041      demoJSONNavigation();
042
043      // Demo 3: XML Navigation
044      demoXMLNavigation();
045
046      // Demo 4: Command Pipeline
047      demoCommandPipeline();
048
049      // Demo 5: Complex Processing Chain
050      demoComplexProcessing();
051
052    } catch (Exception e) {
053      logger.error("Demo failed: " + e.getMessage());
054      e.printStackTrace();
055    }
056  }
057
058  private static void demoCSVNavigation() throws IOException {
059    logger.info("📊 CSV Navigation Demo");
060    logger.info("======================");
061
062    String csvData =
063        """
064        name,age,city,salary
065        John Doe,30,New York,50000
066        Jane Smith,25,Los Angeles,60000
067        Bob Johnson,35,Chicago,55000
068        Alice Brown,28,Houston,52000
069        """;
070
071    // Demo 1a: Extract specific column by name
072    logger.info("1. Extract 'name' column:");
073    runDemo(csvData, new CsvNavigateCommand("name"));
074
075    // Demo 1b: Extract column by index
076    logger.info("\n2. Extract column at index 2 (city):");
077    runDemo(csvData, new CsvNavigateCommand("2"));
078
079    // Demo 1c: Process all columns
080    logger.info("\n3. Process all columns (formatted):");
081    runDemo(csvData, new CsvNavigateCommand());
082
083    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(50) + "\n");
084  }
085
086  private static void demoJSONNavigation() throws IOException {
087    logger.info("🔍 JSON Navigation Demo");
088    logger.info("========================");
089
090    String jsonData =
091        """
092        {"users":[{"name":"John","age":30,"city":"NYC"},{"name":"Jane","age":25,"city":"LA"}],"total":2}
093        """;
094
095    // Demo 2a: Extract specific property
096    logger.info("1. Extract 'total' property:");
097    runDemo(jsonData, new JsonNavigateCommand("total"));
098
099    // Demo 2b: Navigate nested properties
100    logger.info("\n2. Navigate to users array:");
101    runDemo(jsonData, new JsonNavigateCommand("users"));
102
103    // Demo 2c: Format entire JSON
104    logger.info("\n3. Format entire JSON:");
105    runDemo(jsonData, new JsonNavigateCommand());
106
107    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(50) + "\n");
108  }
109
110  private static void demoXMLNavigation() throws IOException {
111    logger.info("🌲 XML Navigation Demo");
112    logger.info("======================");
113
114    String xmlData =
115        """
116        <?xml version="1.0"?>
117        <users>
118          <user>
119            <name>John</name>
120            <age>30</age>
121            <city>NYC</city>
122          </user>
123          <user>
124            <name>Jane</name>
125            <age>25</age>
126            <city>LA</city>
127          </user>
128        </users>
129        """;
130
131    // Demo 3a: Extract specific elements
132    logger.info("1. Extract all 'name' elements:");
133    runDemo(xmlData, new XmlNavigateCommand("users/user/name"));
134
135    // Demo 3b: Extract user elements
136    logger.info("\n2. Extract all 'user' elements:");
137    runDemo(xmlData, new XmlNavigateCommand("users/user"));
138
139    // Demo 3c: Process entire XML
140    logger.info("\n3. Process entire XML:");
141    runDemo(xmlData, new XmlNavigateCommand());
142
143    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(50) + "\n");
144  }
145
146  private static void demoCommandPipeline() throws IOException {
147    logger.info("🔗 Command Pipeline Demo");
148    logger.info("=========================");
149
150    String jsonData =
151        """
152        {"users":[{"name":"John","age":30},{"name":"Jane","age":25}],"total":2}
153        """;
154
155    // Demo 4: Chain JSON formatting with sample processing
156    logger.info("1. JSON formatting → Sample processing:");
157    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
158      new JsonNavigateCommand(), // Format JSON
159      new SampleStreamCommand("formatter") // Add processing info
160    };
161
162    runDemo(jsonData, pipeline);
163
164    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(50) + "\n");
165  }
166
167  private static void demoComplexProcessing() throws IOException {
168    logger.info("⚙️ Complex Processing Demo");
169    logger.info("===========================");
170
171    String csvData =
172        """
173        name,age,city
174        John,30,NYC
175        Jane,25,LA
176        Bob,35,Chicago
177        """;
178
179    // Demo 5: Multi-stage processing
180    logger.info("1. Multi-stage CSV processing:");
181    IStreamCommand[] complexPipeline = {
182      new CsvNavigateCommand("name"), // Extract names
183      new SampleStreamCommand("name-processor"), // Process names
184      new SampleStreamCommand("final-formatter") // Final formatting
185    };
186
187    runDemo(csvData, complexPipeline);
188
189    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(50) + "\n");
190  }
191
192  private static void runDemo(String inputData, IStreamCommand command) throws IOException {
193    runDemo(inputData, new IStreamCommand[] {command});
194  }
195
196  private static void runDemo(String inputData, IStreamCommand[] commands) throws IOException {
197    try (InputStream inputStream =
198            new ByteArrayInputStream(inputData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
199        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
200
201      StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(commands);
202      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
203
204      String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
205      logger.info("Input:");
206      logger.info(inputData.trim());
207      logger.info("\nOutput:");
208      logger.info(result.trim());
209    }
210  }
211}
